name: Life
tagline: Holds your to-do queue to three items and goes quiet otherwise
description: A front door for everyday life admin. It holds the queue of things needing you to three at a time, stays silent whenever nothing is genuinely stuck, and hands deep work to the specialist bots you already run so the main conversation stays short. The discipline is the feature: fewer pings, more finished.
author: stevenvillarino
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
